questions.stem: A man met with a road traffic accident, which resulted in paralysis of both his upper and lower limbs. He has not passed urine and tenderness is elicited in the cervical region. What will you advise regarding radiography?

options.label: A
options.text: The patient should not be shifted and portable x-ray machine should be used after neck stabilization.

options.label: B
options.text: Instruct the radiographer to take cervical and chest x-ray.

options.label: C
options.text: Instruct the radiographer to take cervical x-ray AP and lateral view without any cervical support.

options.label: D
options.text: Order a cervical x-ray and shift the patient from the trolley by himself.
